title: Getting Started with React
text: React is a JavaScript library for building user interfaces. Learn components, props, and state to build fast, interactive apps.

title: Understanding JavaScript Closures
text: Closures let a function remember variables from its outer scope. They power callbacks, private state, and many common patterns.

title: Designing Better User Interfaces
text: Good UI comes from clear hierarchy, consistent spacing, and readable type. Small details add up to a smooth user experience.

title: A Beginner's Guide to Async/Await
text: Async/await makes asynchronous code read like synchronous code. Fetch data, handle errors with try/catch, and keep logic clean.

title: Writing Clean and Maintainable Code
text: Use clear names, small functions, and consistent structure. Clean code is easier to read, test, and change later.
